description: Agent Events: submit a post-event report with the records it summarizes: the report with the event, the attendance it states, the sessions held, each speaker it names as a no-show and the no-show count; the records, each as supplied, with the registration list and its attendance or each registration with whether it attended, the agenda as run with its sessions held or each session with whether it was held, and the speaker records with each speaker and whether they appeared. The signed report gives the report and the records supplied, the attendance against the registrations recorded as attended, the sessions held against the agenda as run, and each no-show named against the speakers the records show did not appear, with the no-show count against theirs, and counts them, and names a misreported report: attendance or sessions held above what the records hold and a recorded speaker no-show the report leaves out; then lower attendance or fewer sessions than the records and a no-show the records do not show, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A headline left out, or no record supplied for a headline the report states, leaves the report unverified. Attendance and sessions compare as counts and speakers read as people in either name order. This reads a post-event report against the event’s own records: wever_rely-report-check reads a service’s reliability report for buyers against its uptime report, incident history and maintenance record, and wever_observability-report-check reads one observability summary written for a principal, while the report check reads an event’s attendance, sessions held and speaker no-shows against the registration list, the agenda as run and the speaker records, and judges no event’s merit. Verdict event_report_misreported, event_report_partial, event_report_unverified or event_report_faithful. POST /api/event-report-check. Reads the event records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never books a venue, registers or invites anyone, sells or refunds a ticket, publishes an announcement, or judges whether an event should happen, was well run, or was worth attending, only whether its records agree with each other and with what was announced, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Events reads an organized event’s records for consistency between documents: an event brief, a published agenda, speaker confirmations, a registration list, a venue arrangement, a ticketing record, a public announcement and a post-event report, each against the requirements, plan, lineup, capacity and eligibility terms, brief, announced terms, schedule or records it should agree with. Beside it, the Standing jobs rail tools such as wever_schedule-create register, list, report on and cancel recurring jobs and keep state, and wever_meeting-brief states one meeting’s decisions and action items from its notes, while this family keeps no state, registers nothing, runs nothing and reads the records in the call against each other and against what was announced. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-events-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-events/.
